chunks: And from him, from several of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from his father, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Husayn, from Murazim, from his brother, who said:

A man said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), 'A boy was born to me.' He said, 'May Allah grant you success, so that you may be grateful to the Giver, and may He bless you in the gifted one, and may he reach his maturity, and may He grant you his piety/goodness.'
ai.seo_question: What is the recommended prayer when a son is born according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) outlines the recommended etiquette for welcoming a newborn son, emphasizing gratitude (*shukr*) to the Divine Bestower. The supplication not only seeks blessings for the child’s physical maturity but also intercedes for his enduring piety (*birr*), linking the joy of birth with the spiritual responsibility of raising a righteous offspring.
